a.xlink:title: Initialize BME680: soft-reset, read chip-id, and calibration data.
This API reads the data from the given register address of the sensor.
This API performs the soft reset of the sensor.
This internal API is used to read the calibrated data from the sensor.
This internal API is used to set the memory page based on register address.
This API writes the given data to the register address of the sensor.
This internal API is used to get the memory page based on register address.
